svg.aria-label: Eight repos into one. Owned the telemedicine backend: onboarding, triage, encounters, Stripe, DoseSpot e-prescribing and labs. Folded eight repos held together by sys.path into one monorepo with twelve packages and CI, then ported it to launch StatWell, a sister brand.
